dict.string: Hippocampus records what you say so the original recording is kept alongside its transcript. Audio is transcribed on this Mac and never leaves it.
Hippocampus reads only the calendars you tick in Settings, so it can bring up what you meant to say shortly before a meeting with the people it concerns. It never changes your calendar.
